name: Start workday
description: List running apps, write a morning briefing, open the workday folder in Explorer, then launch Notepad. Halt if launch or focus fails. Does not close apps.
rationale: Workflow pack: workday setup with folder open (no app closes).

steps.summary: Inspect which apps are already running

side_effects: May create a directory under your home folder

args.content:
Morning briefing
================
- Review calendar and unread mail (manual).

side_effects: Creates or overwrites a text file

steps.summary: List files in the workday folder
Open the workday folder in File Explorer
Launch Notepad as a stand-in for your notes app
Focus the Notepad window if it is open
side_effects: Brings an existing window to the foreground
